name: MetroPlat's human front door is a rich 3D MMORPG/MUD for users and agents
asks: We need https://cold-red-gate.561.group and https://bare-cedar-fog.561.group and other MetroPlat instances to have muuuuuuuch better UX for humans. … we need to meet then beat everyone for what those websites should be. And don't be normie: we want rich 3d MMORPG, fallback to 2d …

x-provenance.recorded-by: Red Cup Engineer Senior, pass farstone-ksp-1 of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus

sources.words: We need https://cold-red-gate.561.group and https://bare-cedar-fog.561.group and other MetroPlat instances to have muuuuuuuch better UX for humans.
make the MetroPlat instances … rich 3D MMORPG-style front doors for humans
MetroPlat as the weirdest wildest coolest UX for the wildest weirdest agentic orchestration platform anyone is making
giving users *and* agents a rich MMORPG/MUD experience

requirements.says: Each MetroPlat instance's public front door shall present the instance as a shared 3D world, with a 2D fallback and a text tier.

requirements.rationale: 2026-10-03: 'Both are one game client on our own engine, qwzspace'.
requirements.says: The MetroPlat front door shall be rendered by the same QwzSpace game client as Farstone.

requirements.rationale: 2026-10-03: 'we almost … have the temples and courts … real world business unfolding'.
requirements.says: The MetroPlat world shall show each enterprise of the board as a place (temple or court) whose offices, open requests and accepted work are visible in it.

requirements.rationale: 'agents doing routines are really going to work'.
requirements.says: The MetroPlat world shall show agents carrying out their routines as visible movement and work within it.

requirements.rationale: 2026-10-03: 'giving users *and* agents a rich MMORPG/MUD experience'.
requirements.says: The MetroPlat world shall be inhabitable by agents through the same interface as humans.

The MetroPlat world shall present coloured Wang tiles and edges, four-colour J26 gyrobifastigium exchange cells, Burgers-vector dislocations, holofoam presence of signed-in players, and Occupy White Walls–style galleries.

requirements.rationale: 'meet then beat everyone for what those websites should be'.
requirements.says: The MetroPlat front door shall be compared capability by capability with other agent orchestration platforms in a dated record that states where it is ahead, equal or behind.
